art_direction: At home a cheerful fictional adult holds two distinctly separate regular phones comfortably at shoulder level, one silver and one deep green, with playful understated pride. The silver phone suggests a premium smartphone and the green one another phone, without logos or identifying hardware. A lively but uncluttered warm room with a window and potted plant. Both phones and hands are clear and naturally proportioned; a calm ivory area remains below the scene. The scene must not contain a foldable phone.
